name: python_func_sig_mismatch
title: Function signature mismatch between caller and callee causing NameError
symptom: A function fails at runtime with NameError or TypeError, even though it looks correct
cause: The caller passes N args but the callee accepts M; or an f-string references a variable that was never bound
fix: Verify the function signature and all referenced variables; add type hints and tests that exercise the actual call path
